m1.typescript: m1 a run grades every case with its own check and reports the pass rate

e1.typescript: e1 an exact check ignores case and spacing but nothing else

e2.typescript: e2 a json field check needs a json object with the field and the same typed value

e3.typescript: e3 a judge check sends the rubric prompt and accepts only a bare score at the threshold

e4.typescript: e4 a model that fails on one case does not stop the run

e5.typescript: e5 tags report their own rates and success criteria judge each dimension

e6.typescript: e6 a regression run names what broke what was fixed and what went missing

e7.typescript: e7 repeated runs expose flaky cases and a case passes only if every run does

wrong-regex-full-match.defect: requires the whole output to match the regular expression instead of searching it

wrong-exact-case-sensitive.defect: compares exact answers without lower-casing them

wrong-exact-contains.defect: accepts an output that merely contains the expected answer

wrong-json-loose-type.defect: compares the field and the expected value as text, so the string 3 equals the number 3

wrong-json-fence-ok.defect: strips a code fence before parsing, so fenced output passes

wrong-judge-first-digit.defect: takes the first digit it finds in the judge's reply instead of requiring a bare score

wrong-judge-strict-threshold.defect: requires a score above the threshold instead of at it

wrong-model-error-passes.defect: counts a run in which the model raised an error as a pass

wrong-tag-total.defect: counts a case in its tag total only when it passed

wrong-meets-at-or-below.defect: fails the overall criterion when the pass rate equals the minimum

wrong-meets-missing-tag-ok.defect: lets a criterion pass when no case carries its tag

wrong-compare-rate-only.defect: calls a run fine whenever the pass rate did not fall, even with a regression

wrong-compare-removed-ignored.defect: ignores cases that disappeared from the set

wrong-flaky-any-run.defect: passes a case when any of its repeated runs passes
